adjunct care: Care provided within a facility where the parent or guardian remains responsible for the child and remains close by, usually on the premises.
adult apprentice: An apprentice who is 21 years of age or over at the commencement of their apprenticeship.
long day care centre: A childcare establishment providing services over approximately eight hours or more each day for approximately 48 weeks or more during the year.
NES: National Employment Standards — sections 59 to 131 of the Fair Work Act 2009.
occasional care: A service that provides short-term childcare.
on-hire: The on-hire of an employee by their employer to a client, where the employee works under the general guidance and instruction of the client or a representative of the client.
out-of-school hours care: A program providing childcare and recreation before and/or after school hours and/or during school vacation periods.
preschool: A kindergarten, day school or nursery school — includes full day care centres and sessional care centres operating during hours and terms approximating those of a recognised school.
vacation care: A service that provides care for school age children during non-term time.
workplace delegate: Has the meaning given by section 350C(1) of the Fair Work Act 2009.
